claims.content: The Customer completes the purchase of auction items by finalizing payment and confirming order details.

goal.raw_text: The Customer completes the purchase of auction items by finalizing payment and confirming order details.

claims.content: Customer
The Customer has items in their cart or watch list that they intend to purchase.
The Customer is signed into their account.
The Customer has a valid payment method on file or is prepared to enter one.
The Customer clicks the 'Save Changes' button after entering or selecting a payment method on the My Account Edit Page 3.

trigger.raw_text: The Customer clicks the 'Save Changes' button after entering or selecting a payment method on the My Account Edit Page 3.

claims.content: The Customer navigates to the 'My Account Page' from the site navigation or after placing bids.
The Customer selects 'My Account Edit Page 3' to manage payment and shipping information.
The Customer enters or updates their payment method details (e.g., credit card, PayPal) and billing/shipping address.
The Customer clicks the 'Save Changes' button to confirm and store the payment information.
The system validates the payment information and confirms successful update.
The Customer proceeds to checkout for items in their cart or recently won auctions.
The system displays a summary of items, total cost including taxes and shipping, and applies any applicable discounts or coupons.
The Customer reviews the order summary and clicks 'Confirm Purchase' or equivalent button.
The system processes the payment using the stored or newly entered payment method.
Upon successful payment, the system displays a 'Bid Confirm Popup' or order confirmation page with transaction details.
The system updates the Customer’s account to reflect completed purchase and removes purchased items from active bidding lists.

If the Customer has PayPal or Amazon Payments as their default payment method, they will experience a different checkout process where they receive a 'Congratulations Winner!' email instructing them to sign in and provide payment information.
Customers with unpaid auction winnings using PayPal or Amazon Payments as default Method of Payment (MOP) will see a 'Winnings Alert' text bar instead of normal promotional text.
Payment must be made within seven days (168 hours) of the auction’s closing date/time; failure may result in account suspension.
Orders not paid for with Amazon or PayPal within 168 hours of being won will be cancelled, item placed into 'Hold' status, and counted as churned auctions in reporting.
When user clicks on 'Winnings Alert' link, they are taken to the 'Returning Winners Payments' page, which includes a personalized Welcome Back Winner! message and instructions.
If credit card was chosen during registration or modification, system displays name on card, billing address, card type (V/MC/D/Amex), last four digits, and expiration date.
User may have two credit cards on file; if so, both are displayed with one designated as 'default', and each has checkbox to delete from account.
In 'My New Payment Method' section, if credit card is chosen, fields for new card type (V/MC/D/Amex), number, and expiration date are provided.
Section includes messaging: 'You can sign up for a free PayPal account at www.paypal.com'; clicking opens PayPal.com in separate window/browser instance.
Section includes messaging: 'If you’ve purchased from Amazon in the past, you already have an Amazon Payments account'; clicking opens Amazon Payments website for registration.
Warning note required: 'Please note: Your billing address information must be entered exactly as it appears on your credit card statement to avoid delays in processing your order.'
Upon saving changes or canceling, user is returned to the My Account page.
If the Customer cancels changes on the My Account Edit Page 3, they are returned to the My Account page without saving payment method updates.
If billing address information is not entered exactly as it appears on the credit card statement, order processing may be delayed.
If payment is not made within seven days (168 hours) of auction closing for items won using PayPal or Amazon Payments, the order will be cancelled and item placed into 'Hold' status.
The Customer’s account is updated to reflect the completed purchase.
Purchased items are removed from active bidding lists.
A 'Bid Confirm Popup' or order confirmation page with transaction details is displayed to the Customer.
If payment was not made within 168 hours for PayPal/Amazon Payments winners, the order is cancelled and item placed into 'Hold' status.
